system.description: The Dragon-Blood channels essence to overwhelm and burn out the target's senses, leaving them diminished and disoriented. When this Charm supplements an attack that deals at least one level of damage after soak, the character may choose to damage one of the target's senses rather than inflict additional health levels. The target suffers a -2 internal penalty to all actions requiring that sense (sight, hearing, smell, taste, or touch) for the rest of the scene. The character's player must declare which sense is targeted before rolling. Against creatures with supernatural senses, this Charm requires an additional success on the attack roll for each level of the sense's supernatural enhancement.
